title: Self-Esteem
subtitle: 「自尊／自我價值／自信」，究竟是哪一種 self-esteem？
description: 「自尊／自我價值／自信」，究竟是哪一種 self-esteem？

words.note: 最直接、最常見的近義說法之一，表示一個人認為自己有價值、值得被尊重和接納的程度；比一般 confidence 更接近 self-esteem 的核心。
words.example: Supportive relationships can strengthen a young person's sense of self-worth.
words.exampleZh: 具支持性的關係可以提升年輕人的自我價值感。

exercises.original: Supportive feedback can improve a student's self-esteem.
exercises.zh: 具支持性的回饋可以提升學生的自我價值感。
exercises.upgrade: self-worth · 自我價值；自我價值感

options.explanation: arrogance = 支持性回饋的目標不是讓學生高估自己或輕視他人。
popularity = 學生是否受歡迎和內在自我價值是不同概念。
self-worth = 句子談的是整體自我價值，而不是單一能力或情緒，因此 self-worth 最直接。
happiness = 回饋可能令人開心，但原句講的是較持久的自我評價。
selfishness = 重視自己的價值不等於自私。
pride = 可以對一次成績感到自豪，但不等於整體 self-worth。

exercises.original: Repeated rejection can damage a person's self-esteem.
exercises.zh: 反覆被拒絕可能損害一個人的自我價值感。
exercises.upgrade: self-worth · 自我價值；自我價值感

options.explanation: confidence at a task = 被拒絕可能影響信心，但原句更廣泛指整體自我價值。
popularity = 被拒絕不只是社交受歡迎程度。
pride = 不是某項成就後的自豪。
self-worth = repeated rejection 對整體價值感造成影響，最自然用 self-worth。
happiness = 情緒低落不等於自我價值受損。
self-image only = 可能受影響，但 self-worth 更直接表達價值感。

exercises.original: The programme aims to build self-esteem among young people who have experienced bullying.
exercises.zh: 這個計劃旨在提升曾受欺凌年輕人的自我價值感。
exercises.upgrade: self-worth · 自我價值；自我價值感

options.explanation: arrogance = 反欺凌支援不是培養傲慢。
popularity = 重點不是讓他們更受歡迎。
selfishness = 不合。
temporary happiness = 太短暫。
self-worth = 欺凌常傷害人對自身價值的評價，因此 self-worth 很精確。
pride = 不是針對單一成就。

words.note: 描述性說法，當 self-esteem 的重點是相信自己的能力、判斷或表現時適用；但 confidence 通常比 self-esteem 更偏能力感。
words.example: Public speaking practice can build confidence in oneself over time.
words.exampleZh: 公開演說練習可以逐步建立對自己的信心。

exercises.original: Her self-esteem improved as she learned to speak in public.
exercises.zh: 她學習公開演說後，對自己的信心有所提升。
exercises.upgrade: confidence in oneself · 對自己的信心；自信

options.explanation: popularity = 公開演說進步不等於更受歡迎。
arrogance = 有能力感不等於自大。
happiness = 可能更開心，但句子重點是對自己能力的信心。
confidence in oneself = 公開演說屬具體能力情境，因此 confidence in herself 比廣義 self-worth 更貼切。
self-image = 未特別涉及外表或身份認知。
pride = 可以對表現自豪，但不是持續的能力信心。

exercises.original: Success in the first few tasks gave him more self-esteem at work.
exercises.zh: 最初幾項工作成功後，他在工作上對自己更有信心。
exercises.upgrade: confidence in oneself · 對自己的信心；自信

options.explanation: self-worth = 也可能提升，但 at work + task success 更偏能力感。
personal dignity = 不是尊嚴問題。
self-image = 不是對外表／身份的形象。
popularity = 不合。
confidence in oneself = 由完成工作帶來的能力信心，最自然是 confidence in oneself。
arrogance = 成功後有信心不代表傲慢。

exercises.original: Coaching helped her rebuild her self-esteem before returning to competition.
exercises.zh: 教練指導幫助她在重返比賽前重新建立自信。
exercises.upgrade: confidence in oneself · 對自己的信心；自信

options.explanation: happiness = 不是短暫情緒。
popularity = 和比賽能力無關。
selfishness = 不合。
personal dignity = 未涉及被羞辱或尊嚴。
pride = 不是單次成就後的自豪。
confidence in oneself = 重返競賽前重建對自己表現能力的信心，這個描述性說法很自然。

words.note: 強調尊重自己的價值、界線和尊嚴；和 self-esteem 接近，但更偏向『如何看待並對待自己』。
words.example: Setting healthy boundaries can help preserve self-respect.
words.exampleZh: 建立健康界線有助維持自尊。

exercises.original: She refused to accept insulting treatment because of her self-esteem.
exercises.zh: 她因為有自尊，所以拒絕接受侮辱性的對待。
exercises.upgrade: self-respect · 自尊；自我尊重

options.explanation: self-confidence = 相信能力不能直接解釋拒絕侮辱。
popularity = 是否受歡迎和界線無關。
happiness = 不是情緒問題。
pride = 可有相關，但此處是維護尊嚴和界線。
self-respect = 維護界線和尊嚴是 self-respect 的核心語境。
arrogance = 拒絕受辱不是傲慢。

exercises.original: Apologising for a mistake did not reduce his self-esteem.
exercises.zh: 為錯誤道歉並沒有降低他的自尊。
exercises.upgrade: self-respect · 自尊；自我尊重

options.explanation: self-assurance = 可能影響外顯自信，但不是道德尊嚴核心。
popularity = 不合。
selfishness = 不合。
happiness = 不合。
self-image = 未涉及如何描繪自己。
self-respect = 承認錯誤仍可維持對自己的尊重，因此 self-respect 最自然。

exercises.original: Healthy boundaries are important for maintaining self-esteem.
exercises.zh: 健康界線對維持自尊很重要。
exercises.upgrade: self-respect · 自尊；自我尊重

options.explanation: self-respect = healthy boundaries 是 self-respect 的典型線索。
confidence = 界線不主要是能力信心。
pride = 不是成就自豪。
popularity = 有時設界線甚至可能降低別人的 approval。
happiness = 不合。
arrogance = 健康界線不等於傲慢。

words.note: 常用近義詞，表示相信自己能處理事情或成功完成任務；和 self-esteem 重疊，但更偏『我做得到』而非『我值得』。
words.example: Her self-confidence grew after she successfully led the project.
words.exampleZh: 她成功帶領項目後，自信有所提升。

exercises.original: Winning the debate increased her self-esteem.
exercises.zh: 辯論勝出提升了她的自信。
exercises.upgrade: self-confidence · 自信；自我信心

options.explanation: self-worth = 可能同時提升，但具體表現成功更直接影響 self-confidence。
personal dignity = 不是尊嚴問題。
self-image = 未特別涉及自我形象。
popularity = 贏比賽不等於受歡迎。
arrogance = 信心提升不等於傲慢。
self-confidence = 具體成功經驗提升『我做得到』的感覺，因此 self-confidence 最精確。

exercises.original: Practice can improve self-esteem before an important presentation.
exercises.zh: 練習可以在重要簡報前提升自信。
exercises.upgrade: self-confidence · 自信；自我信心

options.explanation: self-confidence = 在表現任務前由 practice 建立能力信心，最自然用 self-confidence。
self-respect = 不是界線或尊嚴。
self-acceptance = 不需要接受缺點的語境。
happiness = 不合。
popularity = 不合。
pride = 簡報尚未完成，未有成就可自豪。

exercises.original: The course helped new managers develop greater self-esteem in difficult meetings.
exercises.zh: 這個課程幫助新任經理在困難會議中更有自信。
exercises.upgrade: self-confidence · 自信；自我信心

options.explanation: self-worth = 課程重點較可能是會議技能，而非整體人格價值。
self-confidence = 特定工作情境中的能力信心應用 self-confidence。
personal dignity = 不合。
self-image = 未涉及身份觀感。
popularity = 不合。
arrogance = 不合。

words.note: 較書面、描述性，表示一個人對自己價值的整體感受；與 self-worth 很接近。
words.example: Constant criticism can damage a child's sense of worth.
words.exampleZh: 持續批評可能損害孩子的價值感。

exercises.original: Constant criticism can lower a child's self-esteem.
exercises.zh: 持續批評可能降低孩子的價值感。
exercises.upgrade: sense of worth · 價值感；自我價值感

options.explanation: sense of worth = 持續負面評價影響的是孩子對自身價值的感受，因此 sense of worth 很自然。
confidence in maths = 批評可能影響特定能力信心，但原句沒有局限某技能。
popularity = 不是別人是否喜歡孩子。
happiness = 短期情緒和持久價值感不同。
pride = 不是成就感。
selfishness = 不合。

exercises.original: Feeling valued by others can support a person's self-esteem.
exercises.zh: 感到被他人重視可以支持一個人的價值感。
exercises.upgrade: sense of worth · 價值感；自我價值感

options.explanation: arrogance = 被重視不應轉化為高人一等。
sense of worth = feeling valued 直接對應一個人的 sense of worth。
self-confidence = 可受影響，但 feeling valued 更直接對應 worth。
happiness = 可能是結果之一，但太短暫。
popularity = 被重視和廣泛受歡迎不同。
pride = 不合。

exercises.original: The experience made him question his self-esteem for a while.
exercises.zh: 這段經歷令他一度懷疑自己的價值。
exercises.upgrade: sense of worth · 價值感；自我價值感

options.explanation: ability = 原句不是質疑技能。
popularity = 不是社交地位。
sense of worth = 質疑自己『是否有價值』時，sense of worth 最精確。
happiness = 不是只問自己是否快樂。
pride = 不是單一成就反應。
selfishness = 不合。

words.note: 當 self-esteem 特別涉及一個人如何看待自己、自己的特質、外表或身份時可用；比 self-worth 更偏自我認知形象。
words.example: Encouragement can help teenagers develop a more positive self-image.
words.exampleZh: 鼓勵可以幫助青少年建立更正面的自我形象。

exercises.original: The programme helps teenagers build healthier self-esteem about their appearance.
exercises.zh: 這個計劃幫助青少年對自己的外表建立更正面的自我形象。
exercises.upgrade: positive self-image · 正面的自我形象

options.explanation: self-confidence = 可相關，但 appearance focus 更偏 self-image。
positive self-image = about their appearance 明確是如何看待自己的形象，因此 positive self-image 最自然。
self-respect = 未必涉及界線或尊嚴。
popularity = 不是別人是否喜歡他們。
arrogance = 正面自我形象不等於高估自己。
happiness = 太泛。

exercises.original: Advertising can affect young people's self-esteem by shaping how they see their bodies.
exercises.zh: 廣告可以透過影響年輕人如何看待自己的身體而影響其自我形象。
exercises.upgrade: positive self-image · 正面的自我形象

options.explanation: self-worth = 可能受影響，但 how they see their bodies 直接是 self-image。
self-belief = 不是能力信念。
positive self-image = 身體觀感屬 self-image，而非一般能力 confidence。
personal dignity = 不合。
popularity = 不是社交評價。
self-assurance = 不是外顯從容。

exercises.original: Seeing a wider range of body types can improve self-esteem among adolescents.
exercises.zh: 看到更多不同體型可以改善青少年的正面自我形象。
exercises.upgrade: positive self-image · 正面的自我形象

options.explanation: self-confidence = 不一定關於做事能力。
pride = 不是成就自豪。
self-respect = 可能相關，但 body representation 更直接作用於 self-image。
positive self-image = body types + representation 明確是 self-image 語境。
popularity = 不合。
arrogance = 不合。

words.note: 較正式，表示一個人對自己的評價和尊重程度；常見於心理、學術和較正式寫作。
words.example: The survey measured changes in participants' self-regard.
words.exampleZh: 調查量度參加者自我評價的變化。

exercises.original: The questionnaire measures self-esteem and emotional well-being.
exercises.zh: 問卷量度自我評價和情緒健康。
exercises.upgrade: self-regard · 自我評價；自我尊重

options.explanation: popularity = 問卷可量度社交地位，但這裡不是外部 approval。
arrogance = 不是病態高估自己。
self-regard = 正式心理量度語境中，self-regard 可表示對自己的整體評價。
happiness only = emotional well-being 已另有涵蓋。
selfishness = 不合心理測量構念。
pride = 不是單一成就後反應。

exercises.original: Low self-esteem was associated with greater social withdrawal.
exercises.zh: 較低的自我評價與較多社交退縮有關。
exercises.upgrade: self-regard · 自我評價；自我尊重

options.explanation: self-confidence at work = 沒有特定能力領域。
popularity = withdrawal 不等於不受歡迎。
pride = 不合長期心理構念。
self-regard = 學術描述持久自我評價時，self-regard 很自然。
personal dignity = 不是被尊重與否。
arrogance = 意思相反且不合。

exercises.original: Researchers found that supportive parenting was linked to higher self-esteem.
exercises.zh: 研究發現，具支持性的教養方式與較高的自我評價有關。
exercises.upgrade: self-regard · 自我評價；自我尊重

options.explanation: popularity = 親子支持不等於同儕受歡迎。
selfishness = 不合。
pride = 太情境性。
happiness = 可能相關但不同構念。
self-regard = 研究語體中談 general evaluation of self，可用 self-regard。
confidence in one skill = 範圍太窄。

words.note: 表示相信自己有能力克服困難或達成目標；比 self-esteem 更偏能力與成功預期。
words.example: Her self-belief helped her continue after several setbacks.
words.exampleZh: 她對自己的信念令她在多次挫折後仍能繼續。

exercises.original: Her self-esteem helped her keep applying after several rejections.
exercises.zh: 她對自己的信念令她在多次被拒後仍繼續申請。
exercises.upgrade: self-belief · 對自己的信念；自信

options.explanation: self-image = 未涉及如何看待外表或身份。
personal dignity = 不是尊嚴維護。
popularity = 不合。
self-belief = 面對挫折仍相信自己能成功，最自然是 self-belief。
happiness = 不是短期情緒。
pride = 沒有單一成就。

exercises.original: Strong self-esteem can help athletes recover mentally from poor performances.
exercises.zh: 強大的自我信念可以幫助運動員從差劣表現中在心理上恢復。
exercises.upgrade: self-belief · 對自己的信念；自信

options.explanation: self-respect = 不是界線／尊嚴問題。
self-image = 不合 performance recovery。
popularity = 不合。
happiness = 不合。
self-belief = 運動員在失準後仍相信自己有能力，self-belief 特別自然。
arrogance = 對能力有信念不等於傲慢。

exercises.original: Mentoring gave the student enough self-esteem to apply for a competitive programme.
exercises.zh: 導師指導令學生有足夠自信申請競爭激烈的課程。
exercises.upgrade: self-belief · 對自己的信念；自信

options.explanation: self-image = 不是外表或身份認知。
self-respect = 不合。
personal dignity = 不合。
popularity = 不合。
pride = 申請前未有新成就。
self-belief = 願意挑戰高競爭機會通常與 self-belief 有關。

words.note: 表示一種穩定、外顯的自信和從容；常形容人在社交、工作或壓力情境中的自信表現。
words.example: He answered the questions with calm self-assurance.
words.exampleZh: 他沉著自信地回答問題。

exercises.original: She spoke with clear self-esteem during the interview.
exercises.zh: 她在面試中說話時顯得十分自信沉著。
exercises.upgrade: self-assurance · 自信；沉著自若

options.explanation: self-worth = 是內在價值感，不常用來描述說話姿態。
self-acceptance = 不是外顯表現。
popularity = 不合。
pride = 可能顯得 proud，但不等於 calm confidence。
self-assurance = 面試時外顯、沉著的自信最自然稱 self-assurance。
arrogance = self-assurance 不必帶傲慢。

exercises.original: His self-esteem was obvious in the calm way he handled difficult questions.
exercises.zh: 他處理困難問題時的冷靜方式顯示出自信。
exercises.upgrade: self-assurance · 自信；沉著自若

options.explanation: self-image = 不是自我形象。
self-respect = 不是界線。
personal dignity = 不是被冒犯情境。
popularity = 不合。
happiness = 不合。
self-assurance = calm way he handled 是 self-assurance 的典型外在表現。

exercises.original: Experience gave the new manager more self-esteem when dealing with senior clients.
exercises.zh: 經驗令新經理面對高層客戶時更沉著自信。
exercises.upgrade: self-assurance · 自信；沉著自若

options.explanation: self-assurance = 社交／專業場合中表現出的穩定自信，self-assurance 最貼切。
self-worth = 經驗主要提升情境中的從容，不一定改變整體價值感。
self-acceptance = 不合。
popularity = 不合。
pride = 不合。
personal dignity = 未涉及尊嚴受損。

words.note: 當 self-esteem 的重點是接受自己的優點、缺點和身份，而不是只追求正面評價時可用；是相關但不完全相同的心理概念。
words.example: Therapy helped her develop greater self-acceptance.
words.exampleZh: 治療幫助她建立更強的自我接納。

exercises.original: Therapy helped her improve her self-esteem by accepting both her strengths and weaknesses.
exercises.zh: 治療透過讓她接納自己的優點和缺點，改善了她的自我接納。
exercises.upgrade: self-acceptance · 自我接納

options.explanation: self-confidence = 不是相信某項能力，而是接納整個自己。
self-assurance = 不是外顯從容。
popularity = 不合。
pride = 不是只對優點自豪。
arrogance = 與接納缺點相反。
self-acceptance = accepting both strengths and weaknesses 直接定義 self-acceptance。

exercises.original: She developed healthier self-esteem once she stopped comparing herself constantly with others.
exercises.zh: 她停止不斷與別人比較後，建立了更健康的自我接納。
exercises.upgrade: self-acceptance · 自我接納

options.explanation: self-acceptance = 停止以外界標準否定自己，最貼近 self-acceptance。
self-confidence = 比較可能影響信心，但此處更核心是接受自己。
self-image = 可能相關，但 stopping comparison 更廣。
popularity = 不是別人是否喜歡她。
pride = 不合。
selfishness = 不合。

exercises.original: The workshop promotes self-esteem by encouraging people to accept imperfections.
exercises.zh: 工作坊透過鼓勵人們接納不完美，促進自我接納。
exercises.upgrade: self-acceptance · 自我接納

options.explanation: self-belief = 不是『我能做到』。
self-acceptance = accept imperfections 是 self-acceptance 的直接語義線索。
self-assurance = 不是社交表現。
personal dignity = 不是尊嚴問題。
popularity = 不合。
arrogance = 接納缺點不是高估自己。

words.note: 當 self-esteem 涉及保持尊嚴、不被貶低，以及感到自己值得尊重時可用；語氣較正式，也較偏尊嚴感。
words.example: Respectful treatment is important for maintaining personal dignity.
words.exampleZh: 受到尊重的對待對維持個人尊嚴很重要。

exercises.original: Respectful care helps older patients maintain their self-esteem.
exercises.zh: 有尊重的照護有助年長病人維持個人尊嚴。
exercises.upgrade: personal dignity · 個人尊嚴；自我尊嚴

options.explanation: personal dignity = respectful care 與保持人的尊嚴直接相關，因此 personal dignity 最精確。
self-confidence = 照護方式不主要影響能力信心。
self-image = 可能受影響，但 respectful care 更直接涉及 dignity。
popularity = 不合。
happiness = 不合。
pride = 不等於被尊重。

exercises.original: Being spoken to respectfully is important for a resident's self-esteem.
exercises.zh: 受到尊重地對待對住客維持個人尊嚴很重要。
exercises.upgrade: personal dignity · 個人尊嚴；自我尊嚴

options.explanation: self-belief = 不是能力信念。
personal dignity = 被他人以尊重方式對待，直接關乎 dignity。
self-assurance = 不是外顯信心。
popularity = 不合。
happiness = 可能受影響但不是核心。
self-image = 未涉及自我形象。

exercises.original: The policy aims to protect the self-esteem of people receiving personal care.
exercises.zh: 政策旨在保障接受個人照護人士的尊嚴。
exercises.upgrade: personal dignity · 個人尊嚴；自我尊嚴

options.explanation: self-confidence = 政策不是訓練能力信心。
self-belief = 不合。
personal dignity = 照護政策語境中，protect personal dignity 是非常自然的正式搭配。
popularity = 不合。
pride = 不合。
self-assurance = 不合。

falseSynonyms.zh: 傲慢不等於自尊 arrogance 是過度高估自己並輕視他人；健康的 self-esteem 不需要貶低別人。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Healthy self-esteem does not require arrogance.

falseSynonyms.zh: 自豪不完全等於自尊 pride 可以是對某項成就感到自豪；self-esteem 是較持久、整體的自我價值評價。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Pride may follow an achievement; self-esteem is broader and more stable.

falseSynonyms.zh: 信心只涵蓋 self-esteem 的一部分 confidence 常指相信自己能做好某件事；self-esteem 更關乎自己是否值得、是否有價值。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON You can be confident at a task and still have low self-esteem.

falseSynonyms.zh: 自我形象不等於自我價值 self-image 是你如何看待自己的特質或外表；self-esteem 是你如何評價自己的價值。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Self-image is how you see yourself; self-esteem is how you value yourself.

falseSynonyms.zh: 快樂不等於自尊 happiness 是情緒狀態；self-esteem 是對自己的較持久評價。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A person can feel happy temporarily while still having low self-esteem.

falseSynonyms.zh: 受歡迎不等於自我價值 popularity 是別人對你的社交反應；self-esteem 是你對自己的內在評價。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Popularity is social approval; self-esteem is internal self-evaluation.

falseSynonyms.zh: 自私不等於自尊 selfishness 是過度優先考慮自己的利益；自尊是健康地重視自己的價值和界線。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Self-respect is not the same as selfishness.

falseSynonyms.zh: 自我價值與能力信心不同 self-esteem 偏向『我是否有價值』；self-confidence 偏向『我是否有能力做到』。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Self-esteem concerns worth; self-confidence concerns ability.
